title: Page 25
transc:
S. H. Beckwith ( 2 )  Wash'n Mar. 25th 1864
Chum Katy Oliver Dayton to Comet tulip A 
Dr Trip lett who has escaped from wood
stock Watson that he learned from reliable authority
that Jaunt had ordered all his weasel to
be in readiness by the Allen of April
and that the supposition was that Javelins Penn
was on the swindle yacht The lines working
so badly to Cumber land I send this
direct yawl Nose Palermo Prospecting This is forwarded
to Mohawk by order of Magic yours &c


SH Beckwith ( 2 )  Washn Mar 26th 1864
Gertrude For Chart Yacht Repeats sent to Lonesome to
hold his wedge in read = in = ess tulip I
have al = so seen the Asst Benjamin as you
requested about Ir = on = clads yard stick Recent advices
from Garden represent that Shelby quinces have been greatly
in = creased yacht I think an other wayne of 
Simms Pagan can very soon be tabled & sent 
to the Sexton if desired tulip Laudem will visit
you Wedlock yawl Lady Maj Eckert not returned yet
